incidents.name: H2O transfer-to-pair plus skim multiplies balance
incidents.notes: H2O's _transfer credits extra H2O when tokens are sent to the H2O/BUSD pair, so a 50-round transfer-then-skim() loop multiplied the attacker's balance before it sold into the pool.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xe9c4d4f095c7943a9ef5ec01afd1385d011855a1 created 2025-03-14T07:29:13Z by 0x09aeaec5c8b405370cd04adcc982cb8748d7d447, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x8842dd26fd301c74afc4df12e9cdabd9db107d1e; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
